αἰδοίῃ: αἰδοῖος — revered, august; fem. dat. sg. (Ionic η = Attic -ᾳ)
αἰδοῦς: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve that restrains one before others; fem. gen. sg.

αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βάλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔβαλον)
βασιλῆα: βασιλεύς — king; acc. sg., epic βασιλῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
βασιλῆες: βασιλεύς — king; nom. pl., epic βασιλῆες (= Attic βασιλεῖς)
βὰς: βαίνω — go, step, walk; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist (ἔβην): ’having stepped, stepping’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg.: ’wife’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαιτί: δαίς — feast, banquet; fem. dat. sg.
δαιτυμόνων: δαιτυμών — feaster, banqueter; masc. gen. pl.
δεινόν: δεινός — terrible, dread, awesome; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
δεσμὸν: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. acc. sg.
δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
δημοδόκῳ: Δημόδοκος — Demodocus, the Phaeacian singer; masc. dat. sg.
δημόδοκον: Δημόδοκος — Demodocus, the Phaeacian minstrel; masc. acc. sg.
διί: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. dat. sg. (Διί, from the stem Δι-)
δμῳαὶ: δμῳή — female slave, serving-woman (fem. of δμώς); nom. pl.
δμῳῇσιν: δμῳή — serving-woman, slave-woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
δοκέει: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖ)
δοῖεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they give’
δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
δύσετό: δύω/δύνω — sink, set (of the sun); aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκας: δίδωμι — give; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκας)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg.
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
εἷσε: ἵζω — make sit, set, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.: ’set, seated, stationed’
εὐρύαλος: Εὐρύαλος — Euryalus, a Phaeacian noble; masc. nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θέτο: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’set (for himself)’
θαλάμοιο: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θαλερὴ: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, full; fem. nom. sg., epithet of the voice or of tears
θαύμαζεν: θαυμάζω — marvel, wonder; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐθαύμαζε)
θείη: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might make’ (σκέδασιν θείη ’make a scattering’)
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
θερμὰ: θερμός — hot, warm; adj., neut. acc. pl. (agreeing with δάκρυα) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with λοετρά: ’warm baths’
θρόνον: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour (with footstool); acc. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. · also ’make (someone a certain way)’, with double acc.: ’made him (taller)’
κάλλιμα: κάλλιμος — beautiful, fine (poetic by-form of καλός); adj., neut. acc. pl.
κέκλυτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., reduplicated (κέκλυτε)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κίονα: κίων — pillar, column; fem. acc. sg. (κίων is feminine in this use) · also masc. acc. sg., with μακρὸν agreeing in the masculine: ’a tall pillar’ (πρὸς κίονα μακρὸν)
καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, throughout; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing
καθῖζον: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 pl.
καλυψοῦς: Καλυψώ — Calypso, a nymph; fem. gen. sg.
καλόν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun (καλόν τε μέγαν τε ’fine and tall’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (of a gift: τιμῆεν, μάλα καλόν ’precious, very fine’)
καλὴν: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. acc. sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg.
κεῖθι: κεῖθι — there; adv., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖ)
κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κούρη: κούρη — girl, daughter; fem. nom. sg.
κρεῖον: κρείων — ruler, lord, ruling; masc. voc. sg., a title of address
λαοῖσι: λαός — people, host; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’ · also partitive gen. after a relative: οἵ ... λαῶν ἡμετέρων ’those of our people who’ · also partitive gen. after an adjective of rank: πάντων ἀριδείκετε λαῶν ’most distinguished of all the people’
λοεσσάμενός: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic λοεσσάμενος: ’having bathed’
λοῦσαν: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. act. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’bathed (them)’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέδοντες: μέδων — ruler, lord (part. of μέδω ’rule over’, used as noun); masc. voc. pl., address
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’)
μέσσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc. dat. sg., epic doubled-σ (= Attic μέσῳ): ’in the midst of’
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’
μακρὸν: μακρός — long, far; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’far, loudly’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’tall’ (κίονα μακρὸν ’a tall pillar’)
μεγάρῳ: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. sg.
μεγαλήτορος: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, great of spirit (μέγας + ἦτορ ’heart’); masc. gen. sg.
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα · also modifying a different noun, not a ship (μελαίνῃ φρικί ’with a dark ripple’, of the sea’s surface)
μεμνημένος: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’mindful, remembering’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’
μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor, do not; neg. conj., used to forbid before an imperative · also continuing a purpose clause with the subjunctive: ’and not’ (μηδέ … πάθῃσι ’and may he not suffer’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοίρας: μοῖρα — share, portion; fem. acc. pl.
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μοῦσ: Μοῦσα — Muse; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῦσ’ = μοῦσα)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
ναυσικάα: Ναυσικάα — Nausicaa, daughter of Alcinous; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address
νόστιμον: νόστιμος — of homecoming, of return; neut. acc. sg., in νόστιμον ἦμαρ ’day of return’
ξείνῳ: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); dat. sg.
ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
ξύλα: ξύλον — wood, firewood; neut. acc. pl.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἴκαδέ: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv. (οἶκος + -δε)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα)
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πέρ: περ — even, indeed; intensive/concessive particle, accented πέρ before the enclitic τε/τις that follows it; with εἰ: ’even if’
πήματα: πῆμα — suffering, woe, calamity; neut. acc. pl.
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ) · also neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with a neuter plural noun: ’very beautiful’ (ἔργα ... περικαλλέα ’very beautiful works, fine handiwork’)
περικαλλὲς: περικαλλής — very beautiful; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ποιητοῖο: ποιητός — made, built; masc. gen. sg., epic -οῖο (= Attic -οῦ): ’well-built’
ποικίλον: ποικίλος — inlaid, elaborately wrought, dappled; masc. acc. sg.
πολέος: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πολλοῦ)
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
προκείμενα: πρόκειμαι — lie before, be set out; pres. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προσπτύξομαι: προσπτύσσομαι — greet warmly, embrace, address; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel (= προσπτύξωμαι): ’shall I greet?’
πρόεσαν: προίημι — send forth, send out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic προῆκαν): ’they sent forth’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’)
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’drink’)
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
πύκα: πύκα — closely, snugly, firmly; adv. (πύκα ποιητοῖο ’closely built’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., masc. acc. pl., epic σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by διά: ’through them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέγεος: τέγος — roof (standing for the hall); neut. gen. sg.
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’)
τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg.
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιγὰρ: τοιγάρ — well then, accordingly; particle introducing a response to a request
τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’
τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
τῆ: τῆ — here, take (this); old imperatival interjection used in handing something over
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’)
φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε)
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’ · also ’carried, were carrying’ (φέρον ἐσθῆτα ’they carried the clothes’)
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’)
φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. (φίλοι ’kin, dear ones’)
φαίηκες: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. nom. pl.
φαιήκων: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. gen. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φωνήσασ: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, raise one’s voice; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (φωνήσασ’ = φωνήσασα)
φώνησέν: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, call out; aor. 3 sg., accented φώνησέν before the enclitic τε
φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’
χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
χρυσοῖο: χρυσός — gold; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἀγαυοί: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. nom. pl.
ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’hearing’
ἀλκίνοε: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; masc. voc. sg.
ἀλκίνοον: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; masc. acc. sg.
ἀλκινόοιο: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀλοιφή: ἀλοιφή — fat, oil, unguent; fem. nom. sg.
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀμύμονες: ἀμύμων — blameless (the traditional rendering; the true sense is not known); masc. nom. pl.
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); gen. sg.
ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
ἀοιδοὶ: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. pl.
ἀοιδόν: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. acc. sg.
ἀπαμείβετο: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἀπημείβετο)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀρήτη: Ἀρήτη — Arete, queen of the Phaeacians (name from ἀρητός ’prayed for’); fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., address: ’Arete!’
ἀρήτην: Ἀρήτη — Arete, queen of the Phaeacians; fem. acc. sg.
ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
ἀριδείκετε: ἀριδείκετος — very conspicuous, distinguished (ἀρι- intensifying; the second part is obscure); masc. voc. sg.
ἀρχοὶ: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
ἀσπασίως: ἀσπάσιος — glad, welcome; adv. ἀσπασίως: ’gladly, joyfully’
ἀχνύμενός: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’grieved (though I am)’
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’
ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
ἄελλαι: ἄελλα — storm, squall, gust; fem. nom. pl.
ἄλεισον: ἄλεισον — goblet, cup; neut. acc. sg.
ἄλλοισίν: ἄλλος — other; adj., masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’
ἄξιον: ἄξιος — worth, worthy; neut. nom. sg., + gen.: ’worth (a return)’
ἄπο: ἀπό — away from, from; + gen.; accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (anastrophe: φίλων ἄπο) · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα ’having lost’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἐκέλευον: κελεύω — urge, exhort, bid; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg.
ἐλθέμεναι: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. inf. in -έμεναι (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ‘to come’
ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
ἐμέθεν: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμέθεν (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’of me’
ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’from me’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐπῄνεον: ἐπαινέω — praise, approve, applaud; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
ἐρίηρον: ἐρίηρος — trusty, well-fitted; masc. acc. sg.
ἐρείσας: ἐρείδω — prop, lean, set firmly; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having propped’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθῆτα: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; fem. acc. sg.
ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., predicate: ἑτοῖμα τέτυκτο ’had proved real, had come true’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔθεσαν: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 pl.: ’they set’ (with πὰρ in tmesis: ’set before’)
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’placed’
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’)
ἔν: ἐν — in, on; preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ ’took firm hold’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); acc. sg.
ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc.
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ: ’they put away (desire)’
ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., address: ’leaders!’
ἡγεμόνευ: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, lead; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἡγεμόνευ’ = ἡγεμόνευε)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤιε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ἤιε (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος: ἱερὸν μένος ’sacred might’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ἵστασαν: ἵστημι — set, station; here transitive, moor (a ship); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were mooring’
ἷζε: ἵζω — sit, sit down, take one’s seat; aor. 3 sg. (root form), unaugmented: ’sat down’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη)
ὄλβια: ὄλβιος — blessed, prosperous; neut. acc. pl.: ’blessings’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
